people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Machir
people.line: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
translations.bsb: So Moses gave Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh, and they settled there.
translations.kjv: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt
translations.asv: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
